No triple intersections; the 16 exceptional curves form the triangle-free 40-edge Clebsch graph. Independent exact enumeration of 120 permutations and 16 even translations confirmed all 1920 group actions, all 15 reported (tau,m,a,b) frequencies and 14 distinct first-field count polynomials. Signed-edge traces a-b yield the zeta determinant for ALL extension degrees. This is group exhaustion, not finite-field experimental extrapolation.
